summary: Flash Sports & Media Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with FirstFire Global Opportunities Fund for a convertible promissory note of $880,000 principal at $800,000 purchase price, including 10,000 commitment shares. The note carries 10% interest, matures in 12 months, and has an exchange cap of 10,686,477 shares pending stockholder approval under Nasdaq Rule 5635(d). Proceeds fund working capital. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic review.
